# 🧱 Mason TDD Folder Brick

[![Powered by Mason](https://img.shields.io/endpoint?url=https%3A%2F%2Ftinyurl.com%2Fmason-badge)](https://github.com/felangel/mason)
[![Flutter](https://img.shields.io/badge/Flutter-02569B?logo=flutter&logoColor=white)](https://flutter.dev)

Generate feature folders with TDD architecture, Bloc/Cubit state management, and repository pattern.

## ⚠️ Prerequisites

**This brick works best with projects generated by `mason_tdd`**. For a new project, first generate your Flutter architecture:

```bash
mason make mason_tdd
```

## ✨ Features

- ✅ Clean Architecture separation (Domain, Data, Presentation)
- ✅ Flutter Bloc/Cubit state management
- ✅ Repository pattern with API support
- ✅ GET/POST API endpoints
- ✅ Automatic GoRouter registration in `app_router.dart` + `app_routes.dart`

## 🚀 Quick Start

### Installation

```bash
mason add --global mason_tdd_folder
```

### Usage

```bash
mason make mason_tdd_folder --name userProfile
```

### Configuration

| Variable | Type   | Description                              | Default     |
|----------|--------|------------------------------------------|-------------|
| `name`   | string | Feature name (converted to PascalCase)   | Dash        |
| `dio`   | enum   | API type                                 | get, post, none |

## 📁 Generated Structure

```text
{{folder_name}}/
├── {{folder_name}}_view_model/    # Cubit + States
├── {{folder_name}}_model/         # Data models
├── {{folder_name}}_repo/          # Repository + API
└── {{folder_name}}/               # UI layer
```
